title: Add OpenAI-compatible and OAuth LLM adapters

context.summary: Implement OpenAI-compatible chat support in @mindory/llm and verify API-key/OAuth bearer auth and audit behavior alongside existing text embeddings.
context.background: TASK-72 centralized role/provider support levels. The next step is making the supported OpenAI-compatible SDK path real for chat as well as embeddings.

in: Add an OpenAI-compatible chat provider in @mindory/llm.
Use the existing OpenAI-compatible API-key/OAuth bearer auth settings.
Expose the chat provider through buildMindoryLlm when chat is enabled.
Record operation audit fields for success and failure: role, provider, model, duration, usage, status and refs.
Validate the chat adapter with a fake OpenAI-compatible fetch implementation.
Update LLM docs, support matrix and repository status.
out: Adding new runtime product flows that call chat.
Implementing OCR, ASR, vision, face or generation adapters.
Persisting model audit records to the database.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/llm can build an OpenAI-compatible chat provider.
The chat provider uses API-key or OAuth bearer auth from the centralized config.
The chat provider returns operation result and audit metadata.
Existing OpenAI-compatible text embeddings continue to use the same auth path.
Validation covers fake OpenAI-compatible chat success and audit usage.
Docs describe the OpenAI-compatible chat and embeddings adapter surface.

manual_checks: Confirm no provider-specific imports were added outside @mindory/llm.

risks: Chat adapter must not leak raw bearer tokens through errors or audit records.
Changing the chat support level must not imply product flows require chat by default.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
